question.prompt: Joyce made \(12\) of her first \(30\) shots in the first three games of the basketball season, so her seasonal shooting average was \(40\%.\) In her next game, she took \(10\) shots and raised her seasonal shooting average to \(50\%.\) How many of these \(10\) shots did she make?

solutions.explanation:
The new seasonal percentage applies to all of Joyce's shots so far. After the next game, she had taken
\[
30+10=40\text{ shots}.
\]
Since \(50\%\) means one half, she had made \(40\div2=20\) shots altogether. She had already made \(12\) before that game, so the number she made in the new game was
\[
20-12=8.
\]
Thus she made \(8\) of those shots, choice E.
solutions.title: Use the new season total
